artworks.title: Pacific Threshold
artworks.description: At the Pacific edge of Los Angeles, an empty stairway reaches a threshold holding another sunset.
artworks.alt: Empty concrete stairs descend toward a glowing rectangular doorway overlooking the Pacific under a lavender sky and crescent moon.

artworks.title: The Reservoir Above
artworks.description: Above a Silver Lake reservoir, a second body of water reflects the sky from the air.
artworks.alt: A thin oval plane of mirrored water floats above a still hillside reservoir, stucco homes, trees, and the distant Los Angeles skyline.

artworks.title: River of Returning Light
artworks.description: The Los Angeles River gathers a ribbon of golden light that rises beyond the city into an opening in the sky.
artworks.alt: Golden water runs through the empty concrete Los Angeles River channel beneath arched bridges, then rises into a circular opening in the violet sky.

artworks.title: Observatory for Another Sun
artworks.description: Griffith Observatory watches an immense dark sun, its edge carrying the last warmth of evening.
artworks.alt: Griffith Observatory sits on a quiet hillside beneath an enormous dark sun with a thin glowing apricot corona.

artworks.title: Arroyo Portal
artworks.description: An Arroyo bridge keeps the shape of the city while one arch opens onto an impossible Pacific horizon.
artworks.alt: A monumental concrete bridge crosses an empty wash; its largest arch frames an ocean sunset while neighboring arches reveal the hillside.

artworks.title: Night Orchard
artworks.description: Along an empty palm-lined boulevard, small moons glow like fruit above the road.
artworks.alt: An empty boulevard between white walls and tall palms leads toward downtown, with luminous amber moons suspended above the road and a large crescent in the blue sky.

artworks.title: The Interchange Dream
artworks.description: The city’s empty elevated roads curve toward a cloud that has become a destination.
artworks.alt: Empty elevated concrete freeway ramps curve above the distant Los Angeles skyline, with one road disappearing into a rectangular apricot cloud.

artworks.title: Violet Arcade
artworks.description: A quiet courtyard holds violet horizons in its arches and a single vertical line of light.
artworks.alt: An empty terracotta-tiled stucco courtyard with a potted agave opens through tall arches to violet coastlines and a vertical beam of golden light.

artworks.title: Last Light at the Edge
artworks.description: At the edge of Los Angeles, a lighthouse sends one narrow beam toward a doorway on the sea.
artworks.alt: A white lighthouse on an empty ochre coastal cliff sends a thin golden beam to a freestanding doorway on the violet ocean horizon.
